name: Travel rewards credit cards

apr.notes: Prime + 12.74% to Prime + 20.74% (APR 19.49% to 27.49% as of 03/31/2026). Penalty APR up to 29.99%.

credit_required.notes: Visa Infinite cards typically require excellent credit.

rewards.currency_label: Atmos Rewards Points (Alaska Mileage Plan miles)

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 on all other purchases

categories.label: Dining, foreign transactions, Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: 10% rewards bonus on all points if you have an eligible Bank of America account. Share points with up to 10 Atmos Rewards members. Transfer points to 5 hotel partner loyalty programs (many at 1:1). No blackout dates on Alaska/Hawaiian/partner flights. Points don't expire on active accounts.

signup_bonus.description: 80,000 bonus points and a 25,000-point Global Companion Award after spending $4,000 in purchases within first 90 days. Limited-time online offer.

benefits.title: 25,000-Point Global Companion Award (Annual)
benefits.description: 25,000-point Global Companion Award on every account anniversary. Covers companion's ticket when booking award travel for two on same itinerary, up to 25,000 points. Usable across Alaska, Hawaiian, oneworld and global partners, any class.

benefits.title: 100,000-Point Global Companion Award
benefits.description: 100,000-point Global Companion Award annually after spending $60,000+ on purchases that year. For global redemptions including premium cabins.

benefits.title: 8 Alaska Lounge Passes Per Year
benefits.description: 8 Alaska Lounge passes every calendar year (2 per quarter). Each pass valid for entire travel day, includes up to 2 accompanying children. Premium bar experience through 2026.

benefits.title: 10,000 Status Points Annually
benefits.description: 10,000 status points on account anniversary each year. Every $2 spent earns 1 status point. 20,000 = Atmos Silver (oneworld Ruby); 40,000 = Atmos Gold (oneworld Sapphire).

benefits.title: Free Checked Bag + Preferred Boarding
benefits.description: Free checked bag and preferred boarding for cardholder and up to 6 guests on same reservation. Up to $490 in waived baggage fees on roundtrip.

benefits.title: Waived Same-Day Confirmed Flight Change Fee
benefits.description: Waived fees for same-day confirmed Alaska flight changes. Savings up to $75 per change.

benefits.title: Instant Travel Delay Credit
benefits.description: If Alaska Airlines flight delayed more than 2 hours or cancelled within 24 hours of departure, receive instant $50 voucher valid for 48 hours. Industry first.

benefits.title: Waived Partner Award Booking Fees
benefits.description: Save up to $25 per person on every roundtrip flight when using points to book with partners.

benefits.title: Partner Program Points Transfers
benefits.description: Transfer points to 5 hotel partner loyalty programs, many at 1:1 exchange rate. Covers 25,000+ hotels worldwide.

benefits.title: Free Points Sharing
benefits.description: Share redeemable points with up to 10 other Atmos Rewards members, no transfer fees.

benefits.title: 10% Rewards Bonus
benefits.description: 10% rewards bonus on all points earned if you have an eligible Bank of America account.

lounge_access.notes: 8 Alaska Lounge passes per calendar year (2 per quarter). Each pass valid for entire travel day, includes up to 2 children. Premium bar through 2026.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free checked bag for cardholder and up to 6 guests on same reservation (up to $490 waived baggage fees on roundtrip)
travel_perks.hotel_status: 10,000 status points annually + 1 status point per $2 spent. 20,000 = Atmos Silver (oneworld Ruby); 40,000 = Atmos Gold (oneworld Sapphire).
other: 25,000-point Global Companion Award annually (100,000-point after $60K spend)
Waived same-day flight change fees (up to $75)
Instant $50 travel delay credit on 2+ hour delays
Waived partner award booking fees (up to $25/person)
Free points sharing with up to 10 members

notes: Atmos Rewards Summit is the premium tier of the August 2025 rebrand of Alaska Airlines credit cards. Visa Infinite (not Signature). $395 annual fee. 80K bonus + 25K Global Companion Award after $4,000 in 90 days. 8 Alaska Lounge passes/year. 3X on dining/foreign/Alaska/Hawaiian.
